item.title: SPIDER-NOIR Posters Swing Online As Trailer Release Date For SPIDER-MAN TV Series Is Revealed
item.description: Two new posters for Spider-Noir have been released, putting the spotlight on Nicolas Cage as Ben Reilly and "The Spider." We also have a confirmed trailer release date.

item.title: DAREDEVIL: BORN AGAIN Season 3 Rumored To Feature More Characters From Marvel's Netflix Shows
item.description: According to a new rumor, the third season of Daredevil: Born Again will feature the return of more characters from Marvel's now defunct Netflix shows...

item.title: PONIES Star Adrian Lester On Working With Emilia Clarke, Going Back To The '70s, & THAT Big Twist (Exclusive)
item.description: With Ponies streaming on Peacock, we recently caught up with one of the show's stars, Adrian Lester, to talk about playing the CIA agent tasked with handling Emilia Clarke and Haley Lu Richardson!

item.title: PREDATOR Franchise's Future Revealed Following Dan Trachtenberg's Paramount Deal
item.description: Filmmaker Dan Trachtenberg recently signed a three-year first-look deal with Paramount Pictures, but what does that mean for the Predator franchise? We finally have an answer.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY - THOR: LOVE & THUNDER's India Rose Hemsworth Confirmed To Return As Love
item.description: We now have confirmation that India Rose Hemsworth, who played Love in Thor: Love and Thunder, will join her father in Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday...

item.title: THE LAST RONIN Was Set To Bring TEENAGE MUTANT NINJA TURTLES Star Judith Hoag Back As April O'Neil
item.description: Judith Hoag played April O'Neil in 1990's Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, and reveals that she was approached to reprise the role in The Last Ronin, hinting at it being in the same continuity.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Toys Reveal First Look At The Skel-Knights And Live-Action Rotons
item.description: Masters of the Universe will have a major presence in toy stores this summer, and this newest wave of merchandise shows a green-skulled Skeletor, the Skel-Knights, and the Rotons.

item.title: HELLRAISER: REVIVAL Gets A Twisted NSFW "Love Story" Trailer To Mark Valentine's Day
item.description: The upcoming Hellraiser: Revival video game has debuted a new "Love Story" trailer to celebrate Valentine's Day this weekend, and it features some pretty racy NSFW footage...

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Promo Art May Reveal A Shadowy First Look At The Hulk, Scorpion's Costume & More
item.description: Though the artwork is a little on the blurry side, some new Spider-Man: Brand New Day merchandise seemingly reveals a first look at the Hulk, Scorpion's costume, and Boomerang...
